top_blockers.title: Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) on 'GET /api/resume/{id}'
top_blockers.description: Endpoint 'GET /api/resume/{id}' accepts a resource identifier parameter without verifying that the authenticated user possesses ownership of that resource.
top_blockers.observed_behavior: Direct object reference can be queried by any authenticated or unauthenticated client without user ID tenancy scoping.
top_blockers.expected_behavior: The backend must assert `resource.user_id == current_user.id` and reject unauthorized requests with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
top_blockers.root_cause: Missing ownership assertion in database query filter or authorization middleware.
top_blockers.recommendation: Add user tenancy check in the repository filter or query layer.
reproduction_steps: 1. Send GET to /api/resume/{id} as User A with User B's resource ID
2. Observe server returning 200 OK with User B's private data instead of 403 Forbidden.

top_blockers.title: Missing Requirement: Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoints
top_blockers.description: Authentication endpoints (/login, /token) do not enforce rate-limiting or IP-based throttling.
top_blockers.observed_behavior: Clients can submit unlimited rapid credential attempts without encountering HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
top_blockers.expected_behavior: Production authentication endpoints must enforce rate limits (e.g. max 5 failed attempts per minute per IP).
top_blockers.root_cause: Absence of rate limiting middleware (e.g. slowapi, express-rate-limit, or Redis token bucket).
top_blockers.recommendation: Install and attach a rate limiting middleware to all public authentication and credential endpoints.
reproduction_steps: 1. Send 100 consecutive requests to login endpoint
2. Observe all 100 requests processed without throttling.

findings.title: Missing Requirement: File Upload Size and MIME-Type Constraints
findings.description: File upload endpoints do not restrict maximum file payload size or validate binary magic bytes against an allowlist.
findings.observed_behavior: Unbounded file uploads may cause memory exhaustion (DoS) or allow arbitrary file storage.
findings.expected_behavior: Enforce a strict maximum size limit (e.g. 5MB) and validate allowed extensions (.pdf, .docx).
findings.root_cause: Missing file validation schema in upload route handler.
findings.recommendation: Add multipart file validation checking `content-length` and file headers before streaming to storage.
reproduction_steps: 1. Attempt uploading a 50MB file
2. Server accepts upload without pre-flight size check.

findings.title: Architecture Debt: Direct Coupling to Single AI Model Provider
findings.description: The application instantiates vendor-specific AI client SDKs directly in business handlers rather than using a model gateway or provider-agnostic interface.
findings.observed_behavior: Switching model providers (e.g. OpenAI -> Anthropic -> Gemini) requires modifying core route controllers.
findings.expected_behavior: Encapsulate AI generation behind an abstract `LLMProvider` interface.
findings.root_cause: Lack of adapter / gateway pattern around LLM calls.
findings.recommendation: Implement an `LLMService` abstraction separating prompt templates, provider configuration, and response parsing.
reproduction_steps: 1. Inspect resume generation controller
2. Note direct SDK import `import openai` without gateway wrapper.
